string.text: Enemy Highlighter: the highlight key {KEY} is also bound to {ACTIONS}. Pick another key in Mod Options if this gets in the way.
Turn the mod on or off.

The key that shows the enemy outlines. Left Alt is also the game's Show Indicators key, so both show together. Careful when holding Left Alt: Alt+F4 closes the game, and F4 is a battle order key. A key the game already uses (W, Space, number keys...) will also do its normal job each time you press it.
On: press the key once to turn the outlines on and again to turn them off. Off: the outlines show only while you hold the key.
In toggle mode: if the outlines are on when you leave a scene (walking into the tavern, the next battle), they start on in the next one. Off: every scene starts with the outlines off.
Once per game session, show a message if the highlight key is also bound to one of the game's controls (Show Indicators on Left Alt doesn't count).
In toggle mode, show a short line in the message log each time the outlines turn on or off.
Only enemies closer than this get an outline, so far-away troops don't clutter the screen. Measured from you, or from the camera once you're knocked out.
Only the nearest this many enemies get an outline. Keeps big battles smooth at long distances. 0 = no limit.
The colour of the enemy outline. The two colour-blind colours stay distinct for red-green colour blindness.
On: the outline also shows when an enemy is behind a wall, a tree or other soldiers. Off: only the parts of him you can see get an outline.
Off: enemies who are running away get no outline, so you only see the ones still fighting.
Also outline the horse of an enemy rider. Riderless horses never get an outline.
Field battles, sieges, village raids and custom battles.
Hideout raids, including the fight with the bandit leader.
Arena practice fights, duels and tournament rounds.
Fights inside settlements: alley fights, prison breaks, lord's hall fights and anyone hostile to you while you walk around.
The disguise mission, prison breaks and the sneaking part of a hideout attack. Off by default, because outlines through walls make sneaking too easy.
No outlines while a cutscene plays (such as the bandit leader's entrance in a hideout) or in photo mode. They come back on their own afterwards.
Show chat messages about what the mod is doing: the kind of scene it detected, and how many enemies got an outline. Useful for checking the mod works; turn it off for normal play.
